Q: Good afternoon. This is the adjuster calling about the rear-end collision you reported in Sugar Land. Is this a good
time to record a statement?
A: Yes, that's fine. Go ahead.
Q: Thank you. Please state your full name and confirm you're the driver of the vehicle that was struck from behind.
A: I'm the driver. I was in my own car, stopped at a light on the main road heading toward the shopping center.
Q: Understood. Tell me what happened rgiht before the impact.
A: I was stopped behind a white sedan. The light was red. I felt a jolt and my head snapepd forward and back. I
lokoed in the mirror and saw a pickup right on my bumper.
Q: Did you notice the pickup approacihng before the collision?
A: Not really. I was watching the light and my phone was in the cup holder. I didn't see it until it was too late.
Q: How fast do you think it was moving when it hit you?
A: It didn't seem like a huge speed, but it was enough to push me into the sedan ahead.
Q: Where did you feel pain first?
A: My right knee. It hit the dashboard. Over the next day it swelled up and I couldn't bend it all the way.
Q: Have you seen a doctor or received any treatment for the knee?
A: Yes, I went to urgent care the same evening and I've had follow-up visits with my family doctor. I'm doing physical
therapy twice a week now.
Q: Did you have any knee problems before this collision?
A: No, nothing that stopped me from working or exercising.
Q: Thank you. Is there anything you'd like to add about the accident?
A: Just that I'm still having trouble with stairs and driving for long stretches. I'd like the claim handled as quickly as
possible.
Q: Understood. I'll follow up with the documents we discussed. Thank you for your time.
A: Thanks. Have a good day.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page

- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

- "reason": one short sentence.
